'''Lyhesh Sakku''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] active [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', Lyhesh Sakku's brother, [[Lorjan Sakku|Lorjan]], was the first recipient of the title of [[Barsen'thor]]. Additionally, {{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Tython}}, which depicts the title being awarded to the [[The Barsen'thor|third recipient]] at the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], states that [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] have passed since the title was last awarded. This references the tenure of the [[Barsen'thor (second)|second Barsen'thor]], while the Sakku brothers must have lived sometime prior.</ref> At some point in his life, Lyhesh became the target of an attempted [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]]. He survived, but the incident drove him mad, causing him to become a threat to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Lyhesh was then confronted by his brother, [[Lorjan Sakku|Lorjan]], a member of the Order, who redeemed Lyhesh at the [[Death/Legends|cost]] of his own life.<ref name="TORE" />

His brother's sacrifice was remembered for years to come, with Lorjan being posthumously awarded the title of [[Barsen'thor]] by [[Lorjan Sakku's Jedi Master|his Jedi Master]], which translated to "Warden of the Order" in the Master's native [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]] and which the Jedi Order retained for future use.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyhesh Sakku was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a companion piece to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. Lyhesh and his brother Lorjan were mentioned in an entry on Jedi ceremonial titles, as part of the backstory for the title of Barsen'thor, which is [[The Barsen'thor|attained]] during the course of the game by the [[Jedi Consular]], one of the eight playable character classes.<ref name="TORE" />
